text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.14 -> wave=2, 5% traffic to canary cluster :rocket:

maria (oncall): seeing probe fail rate jump on canary hosts, healthchecks 4xx/5xx increasing

sam (prod-sre): yep 502s spiking across canary-az-1, pattern looks like downstream timeout, not auth

ops-bot: metric alert -> canary.healthcheck.fail_rate > 5% for 2m; 502_count increased by 480% :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): triggering abort criteria from playbook (fail_rate > 3% for 1m). Preparing kill-switch flag. @jeff can you take pager?

jeff (sre): taking pager. assigning incident-12345. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

customer-success: any initial customer impact? I'm on watch for escalations from accounts.

maria (oncall): no customer pages yet, small subset of routed requests may see 502s briefly (canary only). Will cut traffic shortly.

sam (prod-sre): logs show increased time waiting on model backend (kvcache misses + long tail), probably memory pressure on quantized instances.

maria (oncall): flipping feature flag to stop canary traffic: 
```
# feature-flag toggle
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"rollout.wave2_canary","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN"
```

ops-bot: feature flag change accepted by flag-service (id=ff-9012) :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Preemptive rollback job queued (rollback_job=rb-20240315-77)

jeff (sre): starting rollback job rb-20240315-77. Will scale down canary pool and route traffic back to baseline within 2m.

lucy (eng-manager): thx — please confirm customer-facing impact and ETA to full recovery. Prioritize stability over speed.

maria (oncall): routing switched, canary traffic drained to 0% (via kill-switch). Monitoring latency and 5xx.

ops-bot: Post-change metrics: 502s trending down t+45s, healthcheck.fail_rate -> 0.8% :chart_with_downwards_trend:

sam (prod-sre): latency tail improving, KV miss rate dropped after drain. No more memory OOMs observed on canary hosts.

jeff (sre): rollback completed, traffic fully back on baseline. Closing immediate pager. Creating follow-up ticket for root cause and mitigations.

customer-success: marking as "no customer impact" for now, but will notify any customers who reported anomalies.

maria (oncall): incident-12345 created + initial triage notes in ops -> https://redwood/incident/12345. I'll own postmortem and include timeline + perf diffs.

jeff (sre): assign to sam + eng-runtime team for RCA. Action items: reproduce memory pressure under quantized config, add extra _preflight_ mem checks, tighten canary abort threshold in playbook.

maria (oncall): thanks all — handing off to scheduled oncall for long-running RCA. If anything reappears ping @jeff or @maria. :white_check_mark:

sam (prod-sre): acknowledged. will follow up in incident channel with graphs and p50/p95/p99 snapshots.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout aborted and rollback successful. Summary: abort triggered by healthcheck fail_rate threshold -> no customer-impact pages.

lucy (eng-manager): great response — please add a short blameless summary for execs by EOD.

maria (oncall): will do. End of thread.
